title.full: Applying to make a CPF top-up

summary.text: Choose your top-up type, then use its guide to apply.

details.heading: One-time cash top-ups
details.body: You can make a one-time cash top-up via PayNow QR or OCBC Digital, using the CPF Mobile app only. Guides are available on the web and in the CPF Mobile app.

details.heading: First-time CPF transfer to loved ones
details.body: If you are making a first-time CPF transfer to your loved ones, find out which supporting documents you need to submit.

steps.name: Choose your top-up type
steps.text: Choose recurring cash via GIRO, a recurring CPF transfer to yourself if you are 55 or above, a one-time cash top-up, or a one-time CPF transfer. Use the guide for your type.

items: Choose recurring cash top-ups via GIRO, recurring CPF transfers to yourself if you are aged 55 and above, one-time cash top-ups, or one-time CPF transfers.
Use the guide for your chosen type.
